objective:
Build and verify configuration-aware engineering change management on Tracer’s existing foundation. Answer: between two exact engineering configurations, what changed, what remains supported, what may be affected, and what work is required?

First audit configurations, baselines, historical states, comparison, impact, change assessment and verification against a real Tracer change. Inspect the register, relevant needs and architecture; use WORK-004 as investigation context. Register a bounded specification and acceptance criteria before implementation. Reuse existing mechanisms; justify new concepts/protocols through demonstrated gaps.

Define exact configuration membership: stable record/relationship identities, native revisions, external observations/reference states, engineering context, scope and completeness. Separate editable selection from immutable capture. Never silently adopt current states, infer membership from reachability or confuse hashes with retained bytes. Explain comparability across schemas/models/scopes and unavailable history.

Implement deterministic read-only comparison of additions, removals and modifications to records, fields, relationships, references and content observations, retaining exact versions/endpoints and necessary unchanged context. Separate annotation changes, content drift, passage uncertainty and engineering meaning. Preserve deleted identities; disclose bounds/uncertainty or refuse overflow without silent truncation.

Compose comparison with shared impact, change-assessment and verification services. Distinguish changes, potential consequences, assessed impact, outcomes, applicability and remaining work. Bind judgments to the exact configuration pair/policy; changed inputs require explicit reassessment. Preserve prior dispositions/results/conclusions. Explain inclusion/exclusion, retained applicability and required follow-through. Links, reviews and coverage alone cannot establish verification. Shared services own invariants; project configuration owns vocabulary/policy.

Deliver the complete task through shared workspace, core, typed HTTP/client and CLI/agent interfaces: capture/select configurations, compare, investigate, record reasoned dispositions, carry obligations into assessment/verification and inspect outstanding/resolved work. Preserve atomic guards, identities, concurrency/stale protection, drafts and original-intent uncertain-save recovery without automatic retries. Avoid duplicated rules and speculative frameworks.

Prove a justified real Tracer change and a materially different configured domain. Retain original configurations/conclusions, identify affected/unaffected scope and complete appropriate follow-through. Exercise additions/removals, changed links/references, missing/deleted/unknown inputs, partial/incompatible scopes, stale/concurrent proposals, lost committed responses, supersession/reassessment and workload/payload bounds. Use a fresh agent for UI comprehension, address material findings and distinguish representative-human validation.

Preserve identities, history, immutable evidence/conclusions, outcomes and compatibility. Rehearse necessary migrations; verify deterministic export and online/restored SQLite backup recovery. Pass regression, architecture and quality gates unchanged. Update owning docs, checkpoint and register with exact candidate/procedure/results, acceptance, status distinctions, uncertainties, export and backup. Audit every criterion and the full objective before completion.

Exclude restoration/rollback, arbitrary branching/merging, universal release approval, authenticated teams, new backends/cloud integrations and regulatory/arbitrary-scale claims. Success is an implemented, verified end-to-end capability demonstrated on a real engineering change.

Later live native/evidence changes do not alter that pair comparison; switching either side is explicit. Incompatible subject/project/model/schema/scope and unavailable historical information produce explained comparability/uncertainty or refusal rather than inferred equivalence.

Actual six changed/one unchanged source states and no-IO reads are retained; hashes establish neither external byte retention nor passage relevance.

Bounded populations and summaries state completeness and refuse overflow explicitly.

Pair/policy changes require explicit reassessment while retaining prior judgments; closure requires complete accounting under the pinned policy and never implies release approval.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Original actual assessment now completes all 13 candidates with current discovery, zero actions and retained original action identity. Genuine exact-after controlled proof discharges reverification; historical partial phase outcomes retain their original limits.

unchangedOriginalCriteria.expected: Verification follow-through retains exact criterion/method/candidate/support states and explains whether selected recorded outcomes apply to the target configuration, independently of unrelated live-head changes. Existing current-head verification keeps its meaning. Failed/not_run results stay non-passing; generic reviews/status strings cannot override changed governing criteria, incomplete accounting or unknown support. Work executed after configuration capture can support that candidate only through validated exact input correspondence and explicit provenance, never by silently adding membership.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Controlled exact-after case v4 has all twelve current passing obligations, one performed activity fully accounted, current selected basis and authenticated conclusion df399671-0e5b-4602-a46f-bc69753d2840. Earlier current-head semantics and failed/not_run outcomes remain preserved.

Atomic guards reject stale/concurrent/invalid proposals without partial state/history/evidence/outcomes; failed reads pause writes and uncertain writes are inspected without automatic replay. Existing API/storage/receipt/configuration/baseline/assessment/verification contracts retain their semantics and historical readability.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Final-source interface/rejection/recovery checks pass; actual restored core/HTTP/CLI known-intent capture/conclusion/closure/status recovery returns original results without duplicate writes. Every original durable command row remains unchanged.

Drafts survive navigation, stale inputs require explicit adoption, lost responses use shared recovery and supported responsive views preserve exact context. A fresh independent agent completes an unfamiliar task and material findings are addressed; human validation remains separate.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Independent fresh agent completed the unfamiliar synthetic task (8/8, zero actions, exact-target conclusion). Material identity/loading/unknown and actual-project property-reading findings are addressed with final production regressions, including 390px. Actual-project follow-up limits and lack of representative-human validation remain explicit.

A materially different configured domain demonstrates the same semantics. Exact candidate/procedure/results cover additions/removals, reference/content changes, unavailable/deleted inputs, partial/incompatible scope, drift, supersession/reassessment and workload/payload boundaries.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Genuine original capture-enhancement before/after and complete 13-candidate assessment/12-criterion verification are retained; changed and unchanged source scope is explicit. Actual affected REQ-011 and materially different numeric research tasks complete controlled follow-through without rewriting original outcomes or making physical/scientific claims.

unchangedOriginalCriteria.expected: Existing identities, native/evidence history, command outcomes and both prior application capabilities are preserved; necessary migrations are rehearsed and deterministic export/online SQLite backup/restored recovery verified. Appropriate regression, browser, architecture and quality gates pass unchanged. Owning architecture/usage docs, checkpoint and register retain exact evidence, unchanged criteria, delivery/verification/human-validation distinctions and remaining limits. Full goal acceptance is audited before completion.
unchangedOriginalCriteria.resolution: Final native189/schema7/physical format11 preserves original native114 identities/history/evidence/outcomes and both previous application contracts. No physical migration was added. Deterministic canonical export, online/restored backup and exact controlled reads/recovery pass; owning docs/register/status retain exact scope and independent validation limits. Final repository completion audit checks committed preservation before goal completion.
